about: Generated by `python -m evals.run_eval`. Do not edit by hand; `python -m evals.run_eval --check` fails if this drifts.

config.distance: cosine (similarity = 1 - distance, rounded to 3 dp as the API returns it)
config.keyword: BM25Okapi (rank-bm25) over name + category + description, same normalisation
config.default_mode_rule: fixed before the dev run: hybrid is the default unless, with exclusions on, it lowers dev-set MRR or recall@3 below dense; otherwise dense. The held-out set is not consulted.
config.floor_rule: lowest off-topic FP rate among floors costing at most 0.05 recall@3 vs no floor; ties -> lowest floor

dev.label: Dev set (40 queries, in-sample for these changes)
dev.note: The changes were designed from this set's findings (negation ignored, no clean floor), so after-numbers on it are in-sample.

ablation_raw_text.note: Dense, no exclusions (the pre-change API), with descriptions and queries embedded without preprocess_text.
